lines.en: Ziiii ziiii.
I need food!
Watch out! Danger!
Rumble rumble, I’m hungry.
Find food, survive.

lines.zh: 这里有人家，可能有吃的。
lines.en: There’s a house, maybe food.

lines.zh: 我需要力量，去寻找食物。
lines.en: Need strength, find food.

lines.zh: 村庄里有吃的，我去看看。
lines.en: Village has food, I’ll check.
Explore village, find food.

lines.zh: 我的肚子饿了，去找吃的。
lines.en: My stomach’s empty, find food.

lines.zh: 沿着小路，去下一户人家。
lines.en: Along the path, to the next house.
Straw sandals tap the stone lightly.

lines.zh: 我在村口踱步，等炊烟升起。
lines.en: I pace the village gate, waiting for the cooking smoke.
Pacing here.
Traveler, food seeker.
Village dweller.
Pacing at village edge.
Hungry, pacing.
I'm just an ordinary villager.
I am here.
Pacing in village.
Food search area.
Player, close to see.
Player, notice.
Looking at you, player.
Player, I’m coming.
Player, come to me.
Close the village gates early tonight.
Player, notice me.
Player, come over.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进了我的菜畦。
lines.en: Your boots have trampled my vegetable rows.
There are bread crumbs on your sleeve.
Ow, my foot is injured.
This foot really hurts.
The hand holding the bowl shakes; soup spills.
Ow, I fell down.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀被撞了，抬不起来。
lines.en: My shoulder took the hit and won't lift.
My leg is injured.
My wings are broken.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，禁不起一拳。
lines.en: These old bones cannot take a punch.
This stomach really hurts.

lines.zh: 袖口破了，血滴在门槛上。
lines.en: My sleeve is cut; blood drips on the doorstep.

lines.zh: 它盯着你手中的面包，眼中闪烁着渴望。
lines.en: It stares at your bread, eyes glimmering with desire.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物，让它想起了家的味道。
lines.en: Your food reminds it of home cooking.

lines.zh: 你投喂它时，它会发出满足的咕噜声。
lines.en: It makes contented grunts when fed.

lines.zh: 它喜欢吃麦穗，偶尔也会吃些蘑菇。
lines.en: It likes wheat, and occasionally eats mushrooms.

lines.zh: 在温暖的夜晚，它会在篝火旁享受美食。
lines.en: It enjoys food by the warm campfire at night.

lines.zh: 给予它食物，它会用小脑袋蹭你。
lines.en: It nuzzles you when fed.

lines.zh: 它对甜食情有独钟，偶尔偷吃村民的蜂蜜。
lines.en: It has a sweet tooth and occasionally偷蜂蜜.

lines.zh: 分享面包时，它会用小爪子表达感谢。
lines.en: It thanks you with little claws when given bread.

lines.zh: 它的叫声温和，像低语般请求食物。
lines.en: Its call is soft, like a low request for food.

lines.zh: 每当食物出现，它就变得格外活跃。
lines.en: It becomes more active when food appears.

lines.zh: 你的身体碰撞让它受了点伤。
lines.en: Your collision damages it slightly.

lines.zh: 它对你的碰撞反应冷淡。
lines.en: It is indifferent to your collision.

lines.zh: 碰撞中它会发出轻微的叫声。
lines.en: It makes a soft noise in collision.

lines.zh: 你试图接近，它撞你退开。
lines.en: It pushes you away when you approach.

lines.zh: 碰到它的坚硬外壳，你会感到疼痛。
lines.en: You feel pain from its hard shell.

lines.zh: 它撞你时，你感到一阵颤动。
lines.en: You feel a tremor when it collides with you.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞让周围的石块震动。
lines.en: Its collision shakes nearby stones.

lines.zh: 你误打误撞撞到了它，它并不生气。
lines.en: It’s not angry when you accidentally collide with it.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞虽然简单，但很有力量。
lines.en: Its collision is simple but powerful.

lines.zh: 小心它的碰撞，可能会有点疼。
lines.en: Be careful of its collision, it can hurt.

lines.zh: 它在寻找同类，以繁衍后代。
lines.en: It searches for a mate to reproduce.

lines.zh: 它偶尔会发出求偶的叫声。
lines.en: It occasionally makes mating calls.

lines.zh: 找到同类，它会互相追逐。
lines.en: It chases a mate when found.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声温柔而富有节奏。
lines.en: Its mating call is gentle and rhythmic.

lines.zh: 它会用爪子触碰以示亲近。
lines.en: It touches with its claws to show affection.

lines.zh: 求偶时，它会围着你转圈。
lines.en: It circles you when looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，它会高兴地发出叫声。
lines.en: It makes a happy noise when it finds a mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为温和，不具威胁性。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is gentle, not threatening.

lines.zh: 求偶时，它会用头轻轻蹭你。
lines.en: It gently nuzzles you when seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声像轻柔的呢喃。
lines.en: Its mating call is a gentle whisper.

lines.zh: 你扔给我的面包，真好吃！
lines.en: That bread is delicious!
Thanks, human friend!

lines.zh: 这片面包，够我吃几天了！
lines.en: This bread will last me a few days.
Thanks for the bread, goodbye!

lines.zh: 我把这个给你，希望你喜欢！
lines.en: Here, I hope you like it!

lines.zh: 这面包是给你的，别客气！
lines.en: Here, take this bread, no need to be shy!
I don't want this bread!

lines.zh: 我还没吃饱，再给我点面包！
lines.en: I'm still hungry, give me more bread!

lines.zh: 面包没了，我去找别的东西吃！
lines.en: No more bread, I'll find something else to eat.

lines.zh: 面包吃完了，去找别的食物！
lines.en: No more bread, find something else to eat.

lines.zh: 终于找到你了，我的美味！
lines.en: Found you, my delicacy!

lines.zh: 你离我近点，这样更好吃！
lines.en: Come closer, it's better this way!

lines.zh: 来吧，尝尝我的锋利牙齿！
lines.en: Come here, taste my sharp teeth!
You won't get out by this road.

lines.zh: 你走不远，我会追上你的！
lines.en: You won't go far, I'll catch up with you!
You can't run fast, I'll catch you!

lines.zh: 我会抓住你的，我的美味！
lines.en: I'll catch you, my delicacy!

lines.zh: 我要把你吃掉，我的美味！
lines.en: I'll eat you up, my delicious prey!
Don't run, I'm coming for you!
You can't escape, my prey!
That piece in the basket—I saw it.
The flatbread in your hand is still warm.
Something smells from the stove.
That sack of wheat isn't tied shut.
I found a basket of wild berries.
This house's door isn't shut tight.
I'll watch you, you can't escape!
Watch you, no escape!
I'll watch you, don't move!
Watch you, don't move away!
Watch you, can't move!
Watch you, can't run!
I'll watch you, can't run!
Watch you, can't move!
Watch you, can't move!
Watch you, can't move!
Approach slowly—don't scare anyone.
When they turn, I reach.

lines.zh: 我盯着那块面包很久了。
lines.en: I have stared at that bread a long while.
Smile first, then ask.
My eyes won't leave that pot.
I count the fruit in the basket.
Swallow, then step a little closer.
They'll probably give me the leftovers.
I wait for the stove to die down.
That flatbread is waving at me.
It swoops at you with its wings!
It pecks your head with its sharp beak!
You feel its sharp claws!
It pecks your face with its beak!
Its wings hit you!
It opens its mouth to attack you!
Its mouth bites you!

lines.zh: 我抄起木勺，敲你的手背。
lines.en: I grab a wooden spoon and rap your knuckles.
Its beak pecks you!

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍打你的身体！
lines.en: Its wings slap your body!
I bit down—stale bread.
I pick the crust open with a nail.

lines.zh: 推了你一把，只为那块饼。
lines.en: I shove you for that flatbread.
I tap you with a wooden spoon.
I snatch it and run—don't chase.
Bit my tongue—ow.
I tug your sleeve, begging.

lines.zh: 用肩膀撞开你，挤到锅边。
lines.en: I shoulder past you to the pot.
A slap on the table, and the bread is mine.
I kick your shin.

lines.zh: 村庄的夜开始有些不同...
lines.en: The night in the village is different...

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，它出现于村庄。
lines.en: It appears in the village as night falls.
It hides in the darkness.
It roams the village at night.
It quietly waits for the darkness.
It quietly emerges in the night.
It stealthily enters the night.

lines.zh: 夜色里，它的身影更加明显。
lines.en: In the night, its presence is more obvious.

lines.zh: 在月光下，它显得格外危险。
lines.en: Under the moonlight, it looks even more dangerous.
It begins to move as night comes.

lines.zh: 村口的炊烟里走出个人。
lines.en: Someone steps out of the chimney smoke.
I have lived in this village a long while.
Burned by fire.
Fell from a height.
Drowned in water.

lines.zh: 屋墙塌下来，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The wall caves in and my ears ring.
Hit by an arrow.

lines.zh: 我只想安静地扫完这片地。
lines.en: I only want to sweep this ground in peace.
Starved to death.
Hit by lightning.
Fell into the void.
